essence: Continuous gentle sound captivates and overpowers the mind in contemplation.
Fixation of heart and eyes on the lotus-face adorns the contemplative vision.
Even small remnants of feeding activity fully enrich the contemplated scene.
Foam-mixed liquids possess a captivating power over perception and thought.
The calves' alert, raised ears intensify the liveliness of the visualized scene.
